Timeline::TimelineIndexAccessor::difference¶

Back to Timeline Index Accessor API Reference

Signatures¶

Timeline::TimelineIndexAccessor Timeline::TimelineIndexAccessor::difference(const Timeline::TimelineIndexAccessor& other) const

What It Does¶

Returns the timestamps present in self but not in other.

This is the left-only exact subtraction on the axis.

Parameters¶

other

The other time index.

Returns¶

Timeline::TimelineIndexAccessor The left-only timestamps.

Examples¶

Example 1. Remove every timestamp that also appears in the other axis.

auto out = base.difference(right);
std::cout << pluss::timeline::print(out.timeline()) << "\n";

Output¶

Timeline(shape=[3], tz=UTC)
[ 2024-11-01 00:00:00, 2024-11-01 00:40:00, 2024-11-01 01:00:00 ]

Example 2. Use difference() to inspect the timestamps that remain unmatched after exact overlap has been removed.

auto left_only = base.difference(right);

Notes¶

  • The operation is directional: a.difference(b) is not the same thing as b.difference(a).
